T3_about.h2: What VARIANT nbs is and who it is for
T3_about.text: VARIANT nbs is an automated Bio-Rad HPLC system for newborn hemoglobinopathy screening. It uses dried blood spots and is designed for newborn screening. According to the manufacturer, the system detects hemoglobins F, A, S, C, D and E.

items.text: The system automates analysis and produces advanced reports for result review. According to the manufacturer, its onboard barcode reader supports positive-sample tracking.
Capacity of up to 1,128 samples per run supports planning large newborn screening batches. The system uses dried blood spots for testing.
